Registered Nurse - Emergency Department
Alfred Health, Melbourne

About the role
We are seeking a compassionate Registered Nurse to join our busy Emergency Department, providing high-quality, patient-centred care to adults presenting with acute illness and injury.

Responsibilities
- Triage, assess and monitor patients; administer medications and IV therapy
- Respond to medical emergencies and assist with resuscitation
- Maintain accurate clinical documentation and handover
- Educate patients and families on discharge plans and wound care
- Work within a multidisciplinary team of doctors, allied health and support staff

Requirements
- Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Nurse (Division 1)
- At least 2 years post-graduate acute care experience, ideally in ED
- Advanced Life Support (ALS) certification
- Current Working with Children Check and police check
- Ability to work rotating rosters including nights and weekends
